title: The agent's view of the preview: a screenshot tool
request: The owner's goal: Claude Code's capabilities; Claude Code's preview gives its agent a view of the app it builds.
plan: an in-app MCP tool (createSdkMcpServer) that loads a local page in Chromium
a picture and the visible text
local addresses only, never this app

decisions.decision: Chromium from playwright-core, loaded only when the tool runs
decisions.why: the page tests already install it; without it the tool says how to get it rather than breaking a session

change: dclab-code server/preview_tool.js (new), server/engine.js, server/app.js (ownPort), tests, docs.

measurements.name: live
measurements.gate: the agent reads a local app through the tool
measurements.result: Sonnet 5.5 read the page's ROC-AUC 0.842 and 186 of 374 leavers, checked them against random calling, and said what it could not check; $0.10

outcome: The agent sees the app it builds, as the person does.
lessons: Give the agent the same view the person has, under the same limits.
risks: the agent cannot click or type in the preview yet; zod is the SDK's own dependency, not declared here
